1.question: How do I create an account on Jommba?
1.answer: To create an account, click the 'Sign up' button at the top right. Then fill out our detailed form with honest information about your profile, what you're looking for, and your religious expectations. Signing up takes less than 3 minutes.

2.question: Is sign-up really free?
2.answer: Yes, creating a profile, searching for matches, and receiving visits/likes are completely free. You can use the core features with no time limit. A paid Premium Pass is available to unlock unlimited messaging.

3.question: Can I delete my account at any time?
3.answer: Absolutely. Whether you've found your other half or simply wish to leave the platform, you can permanently delete your account from your account settings. All your personal data will be erased immediately.

1.question: Why is my profile pending validation?
1.answer: To ensure a trustworthy environment and prevent fake profiles, every sign-up and every photo is manually reviewed by our moderation team. This process usually takes between 1 and 12 hours.

2.question: What are the rules regarding photos?
2.answer: Photos must be decent and comply with Islamic standards (visible face, appropriate attire). Jommba offers a unique blurring option: you can choose to blur your photos for all members and only reveal them to people you're seriously talking with.

1.question: How do I contact a potential match?
1.answer: When you visit a profile you're interested in, you can send a 'Like' or start a conversation by message if they've liked you back. Premium members can send messages directly without waiting for a match.

2.question: Can I involve my guardian (Wali) in the conversation?
2.answer: Yes, Jommba encourages family involvement. You can add your guardian's (Wali) email address so they receive notifications and can take part in or supervise the conversation as part of a calm, respectful dialogue.

1.question: What are the benefits of the Premium Pass?
1.answer: The Premium Pass lets you send unlimited messages, see exactly who liked or visited your profile, hide your photos from unregistered users, get the verified profile badge with priority, and enjoy a weekly visibility boost.

2.question: Are subscriptions commitment-free?
2.answer: Yes, our subscriptions are monthly with no long-term commitment. You can cancel automatic renewal at any time with one click from your billing settings, at no extra cost.

1.question: How does Jommba protect my data?
1.answer: All your login data and messages are end-to-end encrypted (SSL). We never share your data with third parties and we don't display any ads on our platform. Your privacy stays private.

2.question: How do I report inappropriate behavior?
2.answer: If you notice disrespectful or suspicious behavior, immediately click the 'Report' button on the user's profile or in the chat window. Our moderators will take priority action to suspend malicious profiles.

inscription.q: How do I create my profile?
inscription.a: Download the Jommba app, tap "Sign up" and follow the steps. Fill in your personal and religious details and your expectations. The more complete your profile, the more likely you are to be contacted.
First name, age, city, marital status and your vision of marriage are required. The other details enrich your profile and improve your chances.

inscription.q: Can I edit my profile after signing up?
inscription.a: Yes, you can edit all your information at any time from Settings > My information.

demandes.q: How many requests can I send per day?
demandes.a: With a free account you can send 3 requests per day. With Premium this rises to 10 requests per day, with better visibility.

demandes.q: What happens when my request is accepted?
demandes.a: When someone accepts your request, you can start exchanging messages directly. You receive an immediate notification.

demandes.q: Can I withdraw a sent request?
demandes.a: No, a sent request cannot be withdrawn. Be sure of your choice before sending a request.

messages.q: How do I send a message?
messages.a: You can only send a message once a contact request has been accepted on both sides. Go to the Messages tab to access your conversations.
Yes, all messages are private and encrypted. Only you and the person you're chatting with can read them. The Jommba team has no access.
Yes, you can delete a conversation from the messaging screen. This removes the messages on your side only.

photos.a: Blurring your photos protects your privacy. Only the people you accept can see your photos unblurred. This option is available in Settings > Privacy.

photos.q: How many photos can I add?
photos.a: With a free account you can add 1 main photo. With Premium you can add up to 6 photos to enrich your profile.

photos.q: What types of photos are accepted?
photos.a: Photos must respect Islamic values: modest clothing, visible face. Inappropriate photos will be removed and may lead to account suspension.

premium.a: Premium offers: up to 6 photos, 10 requests/day, seeing who visited your profile, blurring your photos, priority in results, a visible Premium badge, and access to AI features.
Jommba Premium is $10/month (regular price $15/month). You can cancel at any time from Settings > Account.

premium.q: How do I pay for the Premium subscription?
premium.a: Payment is by bank card, Mobile Money (Wave, Orange Money) or PayPal. All payments are secure.

securite.q: How do I report a suspicious profile?
securite.a: On each profile, tap the menu (...) then "Report". Our team reviews each report within 24 hours.
From the person's profile, tap the menu (...) then "Block". That person will no longer be able to see or contact you.

securite.q: Is my profile visible to everyone?
securite.a: Your profile is visible to members registered on Jommba. You can choose to blur your photos (Premium) for more privacy.

compte.q: How do I suspend my account?
compte.a: Go to Settings > Account > Suspend account. Your profile will be hidden temporarily. You can reactivate it at any time by logging back in.

compte.q: How do I delete my account?
compte.a: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. This action is irreversible: all your data and conversations will be permanently deleted.

compte.q: I forgot my password, what do I do?
compte.a: On the login page, tap "Forgot password" and enter your email. You'll receive a reset link.

valeurs.a: Yes, Jommba is designed to respect the Islamic values of marriage. All features aim to facilitate a serious meeting while respecting modesty and religion.
Jommba offers an AI coach to help you write your profile and messages. We are also working on human support with certified mediators.
Profiles can earn a verification badge by submitting an ID document. This verification builds trust in exchanges.
